snippet.title: Go North - Official Release Window Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description:
Wander a world filled with cleverly-crafted mazes. Whoever can solve them all gets their wish granted by the Maze God. Explore beautiful mazes, discover unique items and help other maze explorers complete unusual side quests in this cozy and immersive maze adventure!
Go North is coming in Q3 2026 and will be available on Xbox, Nintendo Switch, and PC.
